reason: A backdoor assignment can simplify a branch directly to the empty formula or to a formula containing an empty clause. The existing v26 SCC implementation accepts unit/binary clauses but does not encode a width-0 empty clause as implication edges.

clarification.empty_formula_branch: SAT with exact EMPTY_FORMULA terminal certificate; no SCC call required
clarification.empty_clause_branch: UNSAT with exact EMPTY_CLAUSE_AFTER_SIMPLIFICATION terminal certificate identifying the reconstructed empty clause; no SCC call required
clarification.nonterminal_branch: must be verified width<=2 and then use the existing proof-carrying v26 SCC provider

unchanged.backdoor_discovery_order: k increasing then lexicographic variable ids
unchanged.branch_order: lexicographic Boolean tuples, false before true
